title: Ops Signal Compass: Monthly roadmap catch‑up and board ask synthesis
creator: Marisol Reyes
description: Synthesize monthly roadmap signals and prepare a concise briefing pack for the exec readout and upcoming board packet. Focus areas: Dedicated capacity runway, short-term tradeoffs for latency vs. unit cost, and risk-adjusted asks for ramp funding tied to Dedicated and Private deployments.
background: Following increased variance in Dedicated capacity utilization and a series of small regressions in tail latency, Engineering asked PM to produce a compact decision slate that connects product tradeoffs to dollars and operational mitigations. Execs requested a 6-slide briefing plus a one-page board ask summary ahead of the monthly QBR.
goals: Produce 1-page board ask with clear decision options and dollar impact
Align key stakeholders (Eng/Infra/Finance/Sales) on ask language and fallback options
Surface 2 immediate mitigations to reduce risk to SLA while we implement larger fixes
success_metrics: Exec sign-off on board ask language by 2026-03-16
Finance confirms budget availability for at least one ramp scenario
Operational action items with owners and due dates created in Linear
No customer-facing incidents attributable to density adjustments in the 30 days after rollout
decision_log: 2026-03-03: Scoped briefing to 6 slides + 1 page ask (approved by VP Product)
2026-03-08: Chose 'Tiered ramp' ask vs 'Immediate procurement' based on Finance feedback (chosen: Tiered ramp)
2026-03-11: Agreed to include fallback policy: auto-degrade to smaller model family if tail latency exceeds 5s for 10% of requests
comments: 2026-03-02 Marisol: Initial outline shared — request feedback on metrics we should include (latency p50/p95/p99, cost/unit, Dedicated utilization)
2026-03-04 Evan: Eng to supply latest utilization report and PRD link — handing off to Infra to validate resource projections
2026-03-06 Jonah Kim (Infra): Uploaded utilization dashboard slice; noted reservation to commit capital without 30-day smoothing window
2026-03-09 Marisol: Draft briefing v0.2 in Drive — link below. Need Sales input on customer commitments that justify ramp
2026-03-11 Finance (Aisha Patel): Confirmed ability to fund Tiered ramp if we meet milestone ‘SLA stabilization’ at end of Q2
2026-03-12 Evan: Merged technical fallback policy into deck; assigned follow-ups to ENG-18765 and ENG-18766
open_risks: Risk: Finance may push to later quarter if stabilization metrics lag (impact: delays to ramp)
Risk: Tail latency regressions could increase support load and erode trust in SLA figures
Risk: Sales needs stronger customer evidence to justify long-term Dedicated commitments
mitigations: Mitigation 1: Short-term autoscale cap + aggressive KV cache tuning to lower p99 within 7 days
Mitigation 2: Customer-facing communication template drafted to set expectations during ramp
Mitigation 3: Run a 2-week capacity smoothing window to validate utilization projections before the board ask is finalized
next_steps: Complete slide 3 (cost vs latency scenarios) with inputs from Finance by 2026-03-14
Finalize one-page board ask and legal review for wording by 2026-03-16
Schedule dry run with Execs on 2026-03-17
Create Linear follow-ups for engineering action items and tag Eng leads
